hard_boundaries.authority_rule: this contract may describe readable combat pressure only; it must not decide admission, membership, session creation, success, failure, cleanup, reentry, progression, credential or settlement.
hard_boundaries.map_rule: candidate terrain responsibilities are diagram_or_whitebox_readability_only; no coordinate, map key, entrance, teleport, spawn, collision or actual map is declared.
hard_boundaries.asset_rule: no Y3 object, unit, ability, buff, projectile, AI, Lua, event, resource or asset is created.
hard_boundaries.economy_rule: no XP, currency, material, equipment, key, drop, probability, pity, qualification, receipt or settlement is defined.

shared_readability_grammar.party_rule: one_to_four_authority_frozen_members_only; every puzzle has a serial single-player path, while multiplayer may parallelize but may not create a fifth-player, permanent-split or simultaneous-hold requirement.
shared_readability_grammar.failure_review_rule: each failure must name a readable source, order, route, node, observation or counter-window mistake; it may not blame hidden numbers or missing output.

numeric_baseline_reference.rule: this Boss-deepening contract keeps its local combat_numeric_values null; it may only reference the external dimensionless phase-exposure, pressure and window coefficients without assigning raw object values, seconds, waves, authority effects or economy outputs.

roles.readability_duty: make line-of-sight fan source and direction readable
make sound-wave ring source and direction readable

phase_grammar.reading_problem: visual and audio patrol orders are separate judgments rather than one area attack
phase_grammar.decision: read the active source before choosing cover, gap or an alternating route
phase_grammar.counterplay: use a cover or gap that solves one judgment, then transition through the visible alternating safe route
phase_grammar.visible_result: one disproven wrong command temporarily loses its executable path
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: two distinguishable cover groups, sound-wave gaps and a central return path remain simultaneously readable

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the player must read timing and mutual conflict between the two order sources
phase_grammar.decision: choose when to wait, rotate or traverse without taking both judgments as one unavoidable pressure
phase_grammar.counterplay: use the contradiction between commands to expose the order source rather than bypass it through output
phase_grammar.visible_result: the conflicting command relation becomes visibly invalidated
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: transition and observation lines do not collapse into decorative blind spots

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the group must distinguish a disproven command from a still-active command
phase_grammar.decision: choose the already-proven alternating route to conclude the gate correction
phase_grammar.counterplay: retain the safe conversion rather than treating the encounter as a damage race
phase_grammar.visible_result: the return line and safe conversion remain readable after correction
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: gate ornaments never imitate the P0 route or command state

party_adaptation.multiplayer_path: members may report or distribute traversal, but every member independently reads both warnings

bosses.authority_boundary: combat readability emits no progress write, session result, completion event, credential or economy input.

roles.readability_duty: show guardian-to-formation chain before body pressure
make verified and wrong formation-eye relations distinguishable

phase_grammar.reading_problem: true and false formation eyes cannot be treated as equal targets
phase_grammar.decision: verify the true eye before selecting an error-recall relation to handle
phase_grammar.counterplay: use the verified relation as the only valid entry to the formation response
phase_grammar.visible_result: true-eye and wrong-recall feedback diverge visibly
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: both branch observations and the central eye remain visible without environmental occlusion

phase_grammar.reading_problem: wrong chain removal must precede use of the guardian pressure window
phase_grammar.decision: break the verified wrong command chain before trying to suppress guardian pressure
phase_grammar.counterplay: turn chain removal into a readable guardian-pressure release window
phase_grammar.visible_result: controlled pressure visibly relaxes or changes relation after the chain breaks
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: side routes remain an observation-and-return solution, never a hidden bypass

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the player must preserve corrected eye history instead of reclassifying controlled actors as the target
phase_grammar.decision: conclude through the corrected relation and retain an available branch
phase_grammar.counterplay: do not replace formation correction with a clear-all encounter
phase_grammar.visible_result: corrected relation persists while unresolved relation remains recognizable
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: the final readable state preserves the chain history across stage change

party_adaptation.multiplayer_path: members may observe different branches or reduce pressure in parallel without replacing verification

roles.readability_duty: make each direction, state and conflict source distinct without color-only coding
visualize command execution without becoming a single-target output solution

phase_grammar.reading_problem: four directions issue commands that can mutually deny one another
phase_grammar.decision: identify which commands conflict before choosing what to observe, defer or process
phase_grammar.counterplay: treat the commands as an ordered relation rather than four isolated clear targets
phase_grammar.visible_result: source and affected route retain a visible correspondence
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: multiple direction states can be inspected without a static terrain deadlock

phase_grammar.reading_problem: route order and temporary split must respect the same visible command relationship
phase_grammar.decision: a solo player orders actions serially; a group may split observation or handling while retaining a shared order
phase_grammar.counterplay: apply a correct sequence so one echo quiets and leaves a stable trace
phase_grammar.visible_result: correct order quiets one echo; wrong order preserves a readable conflict trace
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: split routes rejoin visibly and do not imply permanent independent lanes

phase_grammar.reading_problem: quieted and still-conflicting commands must remain distinct through the final recovery
phase_grammar.decision: retain a corrected path while resolving the remaining conflict
phase_grammar.counterplay: use the stabilized route to prevent a remaining command from negating prior correction
phase_grammar.visible_result: remaining signals do not silently invalidate quieted results
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: the final route is readable as a correction result, not as an unexplained map opening

party_adaptation.multiplayer_path: members may parallelize reading or travel, but the same sequence remains valid for every party shape

bosses.authority_boundary: this prefigures direction relationships only; it does not import mansion rotation, raid qualification or any session state.

roles.readability_duty: make misleading relation pressure traceable to the monitor role
preserve point, link, direction and purifiable-state history

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the current star chart is changing and cannot be solved as a static picture
phase_grammar.decision: observe the direction of change before deciding whether a relation is ready to verify
phase_grammar.counterplay: retain observation history rather than purifying the first plausible link
phase_grammar.visible_result: the observed change remains reviewable across the stage
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: central star-chart state and a short observation retreat remain simultaneously legible

phase_grammar.reading_problem: stable and wrong links require a non-color distinction while monitor pressure remains traceable
phase_grammar.decision: verify the stable relation or use the wrong relation to expose the source of misdirection
phase_grammar.counterplay: never choose a link solely through color or kill the monitor to skip verification
phase_grammar.visible_result: a disproven link gives explicit rejection or correction feedback
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: links, sources and purification state are not hidden by starfield decoration

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the final correction must expose a verified link and a purifiable state before outcome
phase_grammar.decision: correct only the proved relation while retaining the star-chart evidence
phase_grammar.counterplay: turn the stable link into a readable forecast or route display rather than a session or qualification action
phase_grammar.visible_result: the stellar chart visibly returns to a readable forecast or route display
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: the corrected display remains an exhibition responsibility, not an actual portal or entrance

party_adaptation.multiplayer_path: members may observe separate relations or share verification results, while each can independently confirm the critical link

bosses.authority_boundary: a visible calibration result is not TT_SPEC_PROGRESS_CELESTIAL_OBSERVATORY_OPEN, a seven-star session, a mansion session or a qualification write.

roles.readability_duty: use ruler, document and fractured-law symbols to show execution of a wrong order
show source, active rule and purifiable state
show how corrected and forged nodes are recombined before reset pressure

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the enforced rule must be traced to its command-node source instead of solved by attacking the boss
phase_grammar.decision: identify which command-node group forces the current rule and which node is safe to purify
phase_grammar.counterplay: validate the wrong chain before using its purification window
phase_grammar.visible_result: the validated wrong chain visibly enters a purifiable state
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: source, active area and safe transfer line are readable at the same time

phase_grammar.reading_problem: wrong rules cover the field while players retain a visible route to verify and purify
phase_grammar.decision: choose when to maintain a route, verify a node and cross a rewritten area
phase_grammar.counterplay: a correct purification turns a prior restriction into a temporary usable route
phase_grammar.visible_result: the converted route and paused pressure are visible rather than silently resolved
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: central reading, lateral circulation, meeting and retreat remain connected without enabling a bypass

phase_grammar.reading_problem: the core reuses corrected and forged visual history, so players must re-evaluate evidence
phase_grammar.decision: protect verified true nodes and abandon forged nodes based on accumulated evidence
phase_grammar.counterplay: turn preserved true nodes into a visible limit on the core rather than mechanically repeating the prior phase
phase_grammar.visible_result: true nodes create a readable core-restriction and conclusion window
phase_grammar.field_responsibility: true and false history survives stage transition and does not move without a readable transition

party_adaptation.multiplayer_path: members may parallelize already-readable verification, route maintenance and purification without making simultaneous work mandatory
